method: Radial-only inward taper of the dorsal/radial forearm skin between a start station inside the sleeve and the empty band before the first scanned hand ring. Target profile per angle around the forearm-to-hand bone axis: monotone cubic Hermite from the forearm radius (zero slope) to the hand ring radius and slope; applied as a smooth-min displacement of the local smooth radius, weighted by how far the forearm overhangs the hand at that angle. Normals: corner-angle weighted, UV-seam-welded geometric normal change added to the stored normal. Tangents: rotated with their normal (each asset keeps its own tangent convention; w unchanged).
unchanged: JSON chunk, UVs, joints, weights, indices, sleeve, nails, morph targets, images and every other vertex
encoding: Rows follow `vertices`; base64 of little-endian float32 (POSITION/NORMAL VEC3, TANGENT VEC4)
